source: Approved second Angrier Jordan Brand Style Guide only

rules: Never use decorative fonts for dense data or controls

surfaces.border: Slate with functional Teal or Gold emphasis
surfaces.texture: Subtle only; no heavy marble/leather behind text

brand_rules: Gold chair/throne is the primary brand mark; no crown-first branding.
Teal is the primary interaction/accent color.
Gold is reserved for premium/brand emphasis, not every border.
Functional colors override brand accents when state meaning matters.
Discord-native buttons/selects/modals remain native where possible.
